description: One rating of one item by one rater. Blind ratings only count toward a primary analysis.

blind.description: True only if the rater did not know the condition (with/without note) of the item.

item_id.description: Opaque item id from the blind packet, never the trial id.

label.description: The rating: a rubric total (number) or a category (string).

model.description: Model id for a model rater; null for a human. Two raters with the same model id are one source.

rater_id.description: Stable identifier of the rater (a person's code or a model run id).

rationale.description: Why; free text, may be empty only for a null-effort rating, which is rejected.

title: Book-to-Memory rating record
